slides.text: THE TRUTH — Apps in the background mostly sit idle. It's screen brightness and the one rogue app hammering the CPU that drain your battery — not the tabs you closed.

slides.text:
How to tell if your battery is really dying
Check Settings > Battery > Battery Health

Check Settings > Battery > Battery Health

Watch which app sits at 40%+ in battery usage
A rogue location app drains more than screen
